jobs.title: Reception Class Teacher
jobs.school: Honley CE (VC) Junior, Infant & Nursery School
jobs.about: A Church of England village school in Honley, near Holmfirth, taking children from nursery to Year 6. It describes itself as a safe, happy and caring family environment with well-behaved, motivated pupils and a committed team of staff and governors.
jobs.extra: Interviews w/c 30 Nov. Apply by emailing the Kirklees form to office@honleyjin.co.uk (01484 508001).

jobs.title: Year 2 Teacher (12-month maternity cover)
jobs.about: A primary academy in Bradford, listed on Tes. The listing doesn't include more detail about the school. It's outside the default 10 miles, so widen the radius to see it.

jobs.title: Class Teacher (Year 4/5 mixed class)
jobs.about: A village primary just outside Halifax, on your doorstep. The advert highlights a friendly, supportive staff team, good resources, a strong focus on professional development with support for early career teachers, and links with other local schools through a cluster. Visits welcomed (01422 374369).

jobs.title: Class Teacher (maternity cover)
jobs.about: A four-form-entry Church of England junior school (ages 7–11) in Ravensthorpe on the west side of Dewsbury, rated Good by Ofsted in 2023. Early career teachers are welcome to apply.
jobs.extra: Full time. Email the Kirklees application form to office.ravensthorpejun@kirkleeseducation.uk (letter max two sides A4). Visits welcome: Natalie Stalmach, 01924 907082.

jobs.title: Teacher (maternity cover, 0.6 FTE)
jobs.about: A primary academy in the Calder Valley village of Luddendenfoot, between Sowerby Bridge and Mytholmroyd, part of Polaris Multi Academy Trust (six primaries, one secondary and two nurseries). The advert stresses high standards and weekly CPD for staff.
jobs.extra: 0.6 FTE: full days Mon, Tue, Fri (full-time hours possible). Starts 1 Jan 2027; proposed interview 6 Dec. Apply online via MyNewTerm; visits welcome via the school office.

jobs.title: Reception Teacher
jobs.about: A highly diverse, inclusive primary academy in north-west Halifax, part of Northern Education Trust (30 academies across the North). The advert describes a friendly, vibrant school with enthusiastic learners; this post joins the Early Years team and needs strong EYFS knowledge.
jobs.extra: Starts January 2027. Apply online via the Northern Education Trust portal; enquiries to Aneesa Ahmed, a.ahmed@northerneducationtrust.org. Free onsite parking.

jobs.title: Primary Teacher (maternity cover, part time)
jobs.about: A Delta Academies Trust primary for just over 250 children aged 3–11, on the Knottingley/Ferrybridge boundary a few miles from Pontefract and Castleford. It's well outside the default 10 miles, so widen the radius to see it.
jobs.extra: Part time, starts March 2027. Apply via the Delta Trust careers site; visits by appointment on 01977 722458.
